formulas.total_costs: total_cogs + rd + sga + impairment_of_assets_held_for_sale + interest_and_other_financial_charges - other_income

product_sales_yoy.description: Product sales YoY growth rate vs 2025Q1

service_sales_yoy.description: Service sales YoY growth rate vs 2025Q1

cogs_margin_delta_bps.description: COGS as % of net sales, delta vs Q-4

rd_yoy.description: R&D expense YoY growth rate vs 2025Q1

sga_margin_delta_bps.description: SG&A as % of net sales, delta vs Q-4

impairment_of_assets_held_for_sale_abs.description: impairment_of_assets_held_for_sale absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

other_income_abs.description: other_income absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

interest_and_other_financial_charges_yoy.description: interest_and_other_financial_charges YoY growth rate vs Q-4

tax_rate.description: Effective GAAP tax rate for the target quarter (decimal, e.g. 0.14 = 14%; may be negative in a benefit quarter). Choose from the GAAP historical anchors provided; a discrete tax item can push it far from any of them.

noncontrolling_interest_abs.description: noncontrolling_interest absolute dollar value for the target quarter (below-pretax line; predict directly, 0 if none expected).

shares_abs.description: shares: diluted weighted-average share count for the target quarter (predict the count directly; drifts slowly with buybacks/issuance).
